d: Peguam pemalu Mel Dale patah hati apabila dia mendapati adik perempuannya yang berani telah meninggal secara tiba-tiba. Tetapi setelah dia pergi untuk membawa pulang mayat adiknya, dia mula merasakan bahawa ada sesuatu yang mencurigakan. Dan dia mungkin menjadi sasaran seterusnya.
A smart and serious marine biologist and a fun-loving and laissez-faire dive instructor must team up to save their beloved reef from being destroyed before it's too late.

Jenna is a fashion designer who works for her friend's boutique. Their failing business was saved by a famous influencer. When Jenna comes to a lavish Hamptons wedding, she was mistaken for her, but she decides to go along to save business

Landscape architect Evie has met her match with her new client, stubborn archaeologist Ryan, but his daughters love Evie, and she soon finds herself the unwitting victim of Operation Grow a Girlfriend.
